sentences.en: Today is graduation day and I'm exhausted.
sentences.zh: 今天是毕业典礼，我精疲力竭。

sentences.en: I'm a Harvard student and over the last few months, we've just been washing the news scared.
sentences.zh: 我是一名哈佛学生，过去几个月里，我们一直对新闻感到恐惧。

sentences.en: And we've somehow become pawns in this political culture war.
sentences.zh: 而且我们不知何故成了这场政治文化战争中的棋子。

sentences.en: Trump has been coming up with new ways every single day of how to come after us.
sentences.zh: 特朗普每天都在想出新的办法来对付我们。

sentences.en: We're currently in month four and we have a long time to go with this administration.
sentences.zh: 我们目前处于第四个月，而这届政府的任期还有很长一段时间。

sentences.en: So we really don't have a lot of hope that this is going away anytime soon.
sentences.zh: 所以我们真的没抱太大希望，觉得这种情况很快就会消失。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Rachel Abrams and this is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的Rachel Abrams，这是《每日新闻》节目。

sentences.en: I've been very proud to see the university stand up and resist what I think are overreaches from the Trump administration.
sentences.zh: 我非常自豪地看到学校站出来，抵制我认为是特朗普政府越权的行为。

sentences.en: It's not an easy thing to unite a place as opinionated as Harvard.
sentences.zh: 要团结像哈佛这样观点鲜明的地方并不容易。

sentences.en: And yet Trump has succeeded in doing exactly that.
sentences.zh: 然而，特朗普却成功做到了这一点。

sentences.en: For Harvard students, this year's graduation ceremony comes amid an intense standoff between one of America's most prestigious universities and the United States government.
sentences.zh: 对于哈佛学生来说，今年的毕业典礼是在美国最负盛名的大学之一与美国政府之间激烈的对峙中举行的。

sentences.en: I definitely think that some of the administration's criticism of Harvard is valid.
sentences.zh: 我确实认为政府对哈佛的一些批评是合理的。

sentences.en: I've been frustrated by how left-leaning a lot of the courses are, but I don't think the federal government should be trying to force Harvard's hand in this way to fix them.
sentences.zh: 我对很多课程过于左倾感到沮丧，但我不认为联邦政府应该以这种方式强迫哈佛做出改变。

sentences.en: In particular, the Trump administration is trying to cut the school's federal funding and eliminate student visas.
sentences.zh: 特别是，特朗普政府正试图削减学校的联邦资金并取消学生签证。

sentences.en: I'm really concerned about the research that's lost and the projects that are going to be halted halfway through because of these funding cuts.
sentences.zh: 我非常担心因为这些资金削减而导致的研究损失，以及那些被迫中途停止的项目。

sentences.en: We as international students are asking ourselves constantly and each other, what control do we now have over our lives?
sentences.zh: 作为国际学生，我们不断地问自己和彼此，我们现在对自己的生活还有什么掌控权？

sentences.en: We feel bullied by this administration and we just don't really know where to go from here.
sentences.zh: 我们感到被这届政府欺凌，真的不知道接下来该怎么办。

sentences.en: Today, my colleague Mike Schmidt on how that conflict escalated and what it reveals about how far the administration will go to execute its agenda.
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事Mike Schmidt将讲述这场冲突是如何升级的，以及它揭示了政府为了执行其议程会走多远。

sentences.en: It's Thursday, May 29th.
sentences.zh: 今天是5月29日，星期四。

sentences.en: So Mike, we know that the Trump administration has targeted a wide range of universities.
sentences.zh: 那么Mike，我们知道特朗普政府针对了广泛的大学。

sentences.en: The campaign that they have waged against Harvard, though, in particular, it really feels distinct from what's happened at other schools.
sentences.zh: 然而，他们针对哈佛发起的运动，确实感觉与其他学校发生的事情截然不同。

sentences.en: And we've seen this fight really ratcheting up over the last few days with the news about more funding cuts and this attempted ban on international students.
sentences.zh: 而且我们看到这场斗争在过去几天里确实加剧了，伴随着更多资金削减的消息和这次针对国际学生的禁令尝试。

sentences.en: How would you characterize this fight and why is it so different?
sentences.zh: 你会如何描述这场斗争，为什么它如此不同？

sentences.en: We are seeing an administration that is using all different types of powers that the federal
sentences.zh: 我们看到的是一个正在动用联邦政府所拥有的各种权力来打击哈佛痛点的政府，

sentences.en: government has to hit the pressure points of Harvard and to do it in a way that they certainly aren't doing to any other school or institution in the country.
sentences.zh: 而且他们这样做的方式，肯定不是对国内任何其他学校或机构所采取的手段。

sentences.en: It has been a relentless attack in a way that certainly I didn't think an administration was capable of pulling off.
sentences.zh: 这是一种无情的攻击，以一种我肯定没料到政府有能力实施的方式。

sentences.en: And as someone who has covered retribution and Trump's use of his power against institutions and individuals, I've found it pretty remarkable.
sentences.zh: 作为一名报道过报复行为以及特朗普如何利用权力对付机构和个人的记者，我发现这非常引人注目。

sentences.en: It's so interesting that you mentioned retribution, though, because I don't recall whether Harvard actually did anything to Trump.
sentences.zh: 你提到报复这一点非常有趣，因为我不记得哈佛实际上对特朗普做过什么。

sentences.en: When did this fight start?
sentences.zh: 这场斗争是什么时候开始的？

sentences.en: So it all may have happened because of an accident.
sentences.zh: 这一切可能源于一个意外。

sentences.en: Let me try and explain.
sentences.zh: 让我试着解释一下。

sentences.en: Please.
sentences.zh: 请讲。

sentences.en: What happens is, is that after the Trump administration comes in, they start quietly in March having
sentences.zh: 事情是这样的，特朗普政府上台后，他们从三月份开始悄悄地与哈佛进行讨论，

sentences.en: discussions with Harvard about ways that the administration would like Harvard to change how it operates, particularly around the issue of anti-Semitism.
sentences.zh: 讨论政府希望哈佛如何改变其运作方式，特别是在反犹太主义问题上。

sentences.en: There has been a range of reporting about how Jewish students at Harvard were subject to harassment on campus by protesters in the aftermath of the October 7th attacks.
sentences.zh: 有大量报道称，在10月7日袭击事件发生后，哈佛的犹太学生在校园里受到了抗议者的骚扰。

sentences.en: And this was an issue that the far right and Trump supporters and Trump himself have talked about at length.
sentences.zh: 这是一个极右翼、特朗普的支持者以及特朗普本人都曾详细谈论过的问题。

sentences.en: So Harvard had been widely criticized for allowing anti-Semitism on campus.
sentences.zh: 所以哈佛因允许校园内存在反犹太主义而受到广泛批评。

sentences.en: What has also become clear over the last few months is that the concerns raised by the administration are not just about anti-Semitism.
sentences.zh: 过去几个月里同样变得清晰的是，政府提出的担忧不仅仅是关于反犹太主义。

sentences.en: Can you remind us, what else has the Trump administration taken issue with at Harvard?
sentences.zh: 你能提醒我们一下，特朗普政府还对哈佛的哪些方面有意见吗？

sentences.en: The Trump administration had taken a position that the far right had taken on Harvard for a
sentences.zh: 特朗普政府采取了极右翼对哈佛长期持有的立场，

sentences.en: while, that they were concerned about how Harvard was proceeding with DEI policies and using and considering issues like race in a range of different matters on campus.
sentences.zh: 他们担心哈佛如何推进DEI（多元、公平和包容）政策，以及在校园内处理各种事务时如何使用和考虑种族等问题。

sentences.en: To say it another way, it sounds like Harvard was one of the many institutions that the Trump administration is concerned is, quote unquote, too woke.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，听起来哈佛是特朗普政府认为“太觉醒”（too woke）的众多机构之一。

sentences.en: Perfectly said.
sentences.zh: 说得太对了。

sentences.en: So they're having this very constructive back and forth.
sentences.zh: 所以他们正在进行这种非常有建设性的来回沟通。

sentences.en: Harvard doesn't like us to call them negotiations.
sentences.zh: 哈佛不喜欢我们称之为谈判。

sentences.en: They like to call them, because they didn't want to be seen as sort of capitulating.
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢称之为沟通，因为他们不想被视为某种程度上的投降。

sentences.en: And so they're engaging this back and forth about what the administration would want Harvard to do.
sentences.zh: 所以他们正在进行这种关于政府希望哈佛做什么的来回沟通。

sentences.en: And in the midst of this back and forth, Harvard's lawyers say to the administration, like, OK, we have some idea of what you want, but give us some specifics.
sentences.zh: 在这来回沟通的过程中，哈佛的律师对政府说，好吧，我们大概知道你们想要什么，但请给我们一些具体细节。

sentences.en: Tell us what you actually want us to change.
sentences.zh: 告诉我们你们到底想让我们改变什么。

sentences.en: They want a demand letter.
sentences.zh: 他们想要一份需求清单。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So we can go back to the top officials at Harvard and say, look, here's what the administration wants.
sentences.zh: 这样我们就可以回到哈佛的高层说，看，这就是政府想要的。

sentences.en: How can we make a deal to satisfy this?
sentences.zh: 我们怎样才能达成协议来满足这些要求？

sentences.en: Give us a letter that tells us exactly what you're looking for.
sentences.zh: 给我们发一封信，明确告诉我们你们想要什么。

sentences.en: And these lawyers for the administration say, OK, we'll send you that letter on Friday.
sentences.zh: 政府的这些律师说，好的，我们周五会把那封信发给你们。

sentences.en: So Harvard is waiting for this letter from the administration.
sentences.zh: 于是哈佛在等待政府的这封信。

sentences.en: And that Friday comes and it goes and no letter comes.
sentences.zh: 那个周五来了又走了，信却没来。

sentences.en: And then in the middle of the night, Harvard receives a letter from the administration.
sentences.zh: 然后在一个深夜，哈佛收到了政府的一封信。

sentences.en: What does it say?
sentences.zh: 信里说了什么？

sentences.en: The letter is not just what the administration wants Harvard to do, but it's a series of demands
sentences.zh: 这封信不仅是政府希望哈佛做什么，而且是一系列关于哈佛如何运作的要求，

sentences.en: about how Harvard would operate that someone on the Harvard side told me essentially amounts to appointing Stephen Miller, the chancellor of Harvard.
sentences.zh: 哈佛方面有人告诉我，这本质上等同于任命Stephen Miller为哈佛校长。

sentences.en: What does that even mean?
sentences.zh: 那到底是什么意思？

sentences.en: It means that Harvard would have to give up an enormous amount of power to the Trump administration
sentences.zh: 这意味着哈佛必须向特朗普政府交出巨大的权力，

sentences.en: to allow it to see into its admissions, its hiring, what it teaches, the types of people who teach it.
sentences.zh: 允许政府介入其招生、招聘、教学内容以及教师类型。

sentences.en: The demands are extraordinary.
sentences.zh: 这些要求是非同寻常的。

sentences.en: In other words, it sounds like this letter is demanding that the administration get a lot
sentences.zh: 换句话说，听起来这封信是在要求政府对那些可能属于哈佛学术独立核心的事物获得大量控制权。

sentences.en: of control over things that are probably pretty core to the academic independence of Harvard.
sentences.zh: 这不仅仅是违背学术自由那么简单。

sentences.en: It would do more than just fly in the face of academic freedom.
sentences.zh: 它将赋予联邦政府一只手伸进哈佛的日常运作中，这远远超出了我们在像哈佛这样的私立教育机构所见过的任何情况。

sentences.en: It would have given the federal government an arm in Harvard's day-to-day operations that go far beyond anything we've seen at a private education university like Harvard.
sentences.zh: 那么哈佛对此有何反应？

sentences.en: So how does Harvard react to this?
sentences.zh: 哈佛做出了一个非同寻常的决定。

sentences.en: So Harvard makes an extraordinary decision.
sentences.zh: 那个周末，他们认为特朗普政府的要求太过分了，

sentences.en: Over that weekend, they decide that the demands from the Trump administration are so great that
sentences.zh: 他们别无选择，只能公开拒绝，对抗特朗普并为自己挺身而出。

sentences.en: they have no choice but to publicly rebuff this and take on Trump and stand up for themselves.
sentences.zh: 回想一下当时的情况，这发生在哥伦比亚大学基本上向政府提出的类似要求清单投降之后，

sentences.en: And just to remember what's happening at this moment, this is coming after Columbia basically capitulated
sentences.zh: 为了获得学校的资助。

sentences.en: to a similar list of demands that the administration was making in order to provide that school with funding.
sentences.zh: 所以当你说是非同寻常的决定时，你的意思是他们的反应与我们之前看到的大学校长处理特朗普政府的方式截然不同，对吧？

sentences.en: So when you say that this was an extraordinary decision, you mean because like their response
sentences.zh: 而且这与国内一系列顶级律师事务所的做法大相径庭，那些律所也曾进入椭圆形办公室与特朗普达成交易，以阻止针对他们的行政命令。

sentences.en: is so different from what we saw up until that point about how university presidents were dealing with the Trump administration, right?
sentences.zh: 所以那个周一，在没有回复政府的情况下，哈佛发布了一封信，本质上说我们绝不会同意这些要求。

sentences.en: And it's vastly different than a series of top law firms in the country who were also going
sentences.zh: 我们立场坚定，我们将采取一切必要措施来保护我们的独立性。

sentences.en: in to the Oval Office to make deals with Trump to head off executive orders against them.
sentences.zh: 在发布这封信和哈佛校长声明的同时，哈佛还公布了政府在那个周五晚上发给他们的信的副本。

sentences.en: So that Monday, without going back to the administration, Harvard puts out a letter that essentially says there is no way we are going along with any of this.
sentences.zh: 所以他们真的希望人们亲自看到这些要求。

sentences.en: We are putting our foot down and we are going to do whatever we need to do to protect our independence.
sentences.zh: 他们想让世界看到。

sentences.en: Along with putting out their letter and a statement from Harvard's president, Harvard puts out a copy of the letter that the administration had sent them that Friday night.
sentences.zh: 看看这些要求有多疯狂。

sentences.en: So they really want people to see the demands for themselves.
sentences.zh: 看看这封信，你就会明白为什么我们决定别无选择，只能反击。

sentences.en: They want the world to see.
sentences.zh: 就在哈佛发布这一切后不久，哈佛的律师接到了一个来自特朗普政府律师的疯狂电话，他们之前一直在与此人谈判。

sentences.en: Look at how crazy these demands are.
sentences.zh: 他说了什么？

sentences.en: Look at this letter and you can see why we decided we had no choice but to fight.
sentences.zh: 他说，呃，你们周五收到的那封信，现在成了哈佛决定对抗特朗普政府的核心问题，那封信

sentences.en: And almost immediately after Harvard puts all of this out, Harvard's lawyers receive a frantic call from a lawyer in the Trump administration who they had been negotiating with.
sentences.zh: 本不应该发出的。

sentences.en: And what does he say?
sentences.zh: 你怎么看这件事？

sentences.en: He says, uh, that letter that you guys got on Friday, that now is like the center of the whole issue for why Harvard has decided to take on the Trump administration, that letter
sentences.zh: 你相信吗？

sentences.en: wasn't supposed to be sent out.
sentences.zh: 他们相信吗？

sentences.en: What do you make of that?
sentences.zh: 这是哈佛故事中的一大谜团。

sentences.en: Do you believe that?
sentences.zh: 他们是故意发那封信的吗？

sentences.en: Did they believe that?
sentences.zh: 是发错了信吗？

sentences.en: It's one of the great mysteries of the Harvard story.
sentences.zh: 还是在错误的时间发出的？

sentences.en: Did they mean to send the letter?
sentences.zh: 或者是政府玩过火了？

sentences.en: Was the wrong letter sent?
sentences.zh: 他们发出的信件，他们以为是谈判，但却如此极端，如此不可接受，以至于哈佛认为他们别无选择，只能反击？

sentences.en: Was it sent at the wrong time?
sentences.zh: 他们基本上是看穿了对方的虚张声势吗？

sentences.en: Or did the administration overplay their hand?
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Did they send a letter that they thought was negotiation, but was just so extreme and so beyond the pale that Harvard thought they had no choice but to fight?
sentences.zh: 这就像如果你和我正在谈判，你对我说，Mike，我给你25美分。

sentences.en: Did they call their bluff basically?
sentences.zh: 我说，75美分怎么样？

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 我们正在真诚地进行来回沟通。

sentences.en: It's like, it would be like if you and I were negotiating and you said to me, Mike, I'll give you 25 cents.
sentences.zh: 然后突然间我走进来，说，给我20美元。

sentences.en: And I said, what about 75 cents?
sentences.zh: 你会说，搞什么鬼，Mike？

sentences.en: And we're going back and forth in good faith.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我可能只有50美分或75美分。

sentences.en: And then all of a sudden I walk in and I'm like, give me $20.
sentences.zh: 如果这就是你想要的，我根本不可能和你达成交易。

sentences.en: And you're like, what the heck, Mike?
sentences.zh: 这基本上就是这里发生的事情。

sentences.en: You know, I only have like maybe 50 cents, 75 cents.
sentences.zh: 你基本上是说哈佛看着这封要求信，觉得根本没有什么可谈判的。

sentences.en: Like, there's no way I could give you $20.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Sorry, there's no way I can make a deal with you if that's what you want.
sentences.zh: 但那时，战争已经开始了。

sentences.en: And that's sort of what happened here.
sentences.zh: 哈佛已经宣布要拒绝特朗普。

sentences.en: You're basically saying that Harvard is looking at this demand letter being like, there's nothing to even negotiate with.
sentences.zh: 当天晚些时候，白宫宣布哈佛将开始失去其为学校研究项目所获得的很大一部分联邦资金。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 几天后，哈佛诉诸法庭，起诉政府，试图追回那些因拒绝配合特朗普要求而被剥夺的资金。

sentences.en: But at that point, the war had already begun.
sentences.zh: 告诉我们关于这场诉讼以及哈佛究竟是如何反击的。

sentences.en: Harvard had already declared that it was going to rebuff Trump.
sentences.zh: 好吧，哈佛带着国内两位顶尖的保守派律师作为法律团队的负责人走上了法庭。

sentences.en: And by the end of that day, the White House announces that Harvard will start to lose major portions of federal funding that it receives for research the school does.
sentences.zh: 处理不当的机密文件。

sentences.en: And just days later, Harvard goes to court and sues the administration to get back the money
sentences.zh: Robert Hurd是那个称拜登为记忆力不佳的老年人的人吗？

sentences.en: Trump has stripped away from them for their refusal to go along with what he wants.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Tell us about the lawsuit and how exactly Harvard is fighting it.
sentences.zh: 然后他们还有Bill Burke，他是特朗普圈子里一位知名的律师，即使在当时也是特朗普集团的外部道德顾问。

sentences.en: Well, Harvard goes to court with two of the top conservative lawyers in the country at the head of their legal team.
sentences.zh: 所以很明显，他们试图引入那些了解政府并对他们的思维方式有良好判断力的人。

sentences.en: Mishandled classified documents.
sentences.zh: 那些能够弥合政府想要的东西与被针对者之间差距的人，那些可能达成交易的人。

sentences.en: Is Robert Hurd the one that called Biden an elderly man with a poor memory?
sentences.zh: 那么哈佛的法律论据到底是什么？

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 哈佛本质上是在说，你们在没有任何程序、甚至没有调查我们的情况下，不公平地剥夺了我们的资金，

sentences.en: And then they had Bill Burke, who is a well-known lawyer in Trump's orbit, who even at the time was the outside ethics advisor to the Trump organization.
sentences.zh: 而且你们这样做的方式实际上侵犯了我们的第一修正案权利，因为你们试图在这里侵犯我们课堂内发生的事情。

sentences.en: So clearly, they're trying to bring in people that would understand the administration and have some good sense of how they're thinking.
sentences.zh: 哈佛还说，看，如果你说的是关于校园内反犹太主义的问题，那么癌症研究资金与反犹太主义有什么关系？

sentences.en: People who could bridge the gap between what the administration wants and those that are targeted by it, who could potentially make a deal.
sentences.zh: 随着案件的推进，哈佛看起来确实占据了上风。

sentences.en: So what is Harvard's legal argument exactly?
sentences.zh: 法律专家表示，他们有一个非常合理的案件，可能很快就会在法庭上获胜并拿回他们的钱。

sentences.en: What Harvard's essentially saying is that you have unfairly taken away our money without any
sentences.zh: 哈佛也因其反击的意愿而受到广泛赞誉。

sentences.en: process without even investigating us, and you've done it in a way that actually violates our First
sentences.zh: 人们有一种感觉，不仅是哈佛在采取立场，而且哈佛必须采取立场，因为他们处于反击的独特位置。

sentences.en: Amendment rights, because you're trying to infringe here on what happens inside of our classrooMs.
sentences.zh: 他们拥有巨大的资源和能力。

sentences.en: And Harvard's also saying, look, if you're saying this about how anti-Semitism is on campus, what does funding for cancer research have to do with anti-Semitism?
sentences.zh: 如果他们都不反击，那还有谁会呢？

sentences.en: And as this court case is proceeding, Harvard looks like it really has the wind at its back.
sentences.zh: 33位总统。

sentences.en: Legal experts are saying that they have a very valid case and could quickly win in court and get their money back.
sentences.zh: 我在凌晨4点半给总统打了电话，他接了。

sentences.en: Harvard is also being widely praised for its willingness to fight back.
sentences.zh: 太空探索七十年。

sentences.en: There's a feeling that not only is Harvard taking a stand, but like Harvard has to take a stand because they are uniquely positioned to fight back.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗恒星之外有什么。

sentences.en: They have an enormous amount of resources and abilities.
sentences.zh: 一千份消费品指南。

sentences.en: And if they're not going to fight back, then who is?
sentences.zh: 今天我正在测试七款床垫。

sentences.en: But at the same time, as it appears like all the momentum is heading in Harvard's way, I start to hear from
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，尽管看起来所有势头都倒向了哈佛大学，但我开始听到

sentences.en: folks that I'm talking to that Harvard's problems may be much bigger than just winning this legal case.
sentences.zh: 我交谈的对象说，哈佛面临的问题可能远不止赢得这场官司这么简单。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们稍后回来。

sentences.en: I'm Winnalou.
sentences.zh: 我是 Winnalou。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games, and I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我负责编写《纽约时报》游戏中的《Connections》谜题，我非常喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog and I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗，也喜欢尝试捉弄你们。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Azersky and I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我是 Sam Azersky，我每天负责制作《Spelling Bee》和《Letterboxd》游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做“联觉”的特质。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我在听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由像刚才你们听到的那些人制作的。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com/games，今天就开始玩吧。

sentences.en: Mike, you just told us that there's a feeling out there that Harvard is one of the best equipped institutions to fight the Trump administration.
sentences.zh: Mike，你刚才告诉我们，外界有一种感觉，认为哈佛是应对特朗普政府最有实力的机构之一。

sentences.en: But yet there are people inside Harvard that still feel like they have all of these problems no matter which way the lawsuit goes.
sentences.zh: 但哈佛内部仍有人觉得，无论诉讼结果如何，他们都面临着所有这些问题。

sentences.en: So what are those problems exactly?
sentences.zh: 那么这些问题究竟是什么呢？

sentences.en: What I was coming to understand was that the court case only related to funding that the
sentences.zh: 我逐渐了解到，这起诉讼仅涉及特朗普政府

sentences.en: Trump administration had already frozen in that even if Harvard was to prevail in court, they would still need to get funding in the years that followed.
sentences.zh: 已经冻结的资金，这意味着即使哈佛在法庭上胜诉，他们在随后的几年里仍需要获得资金。

sentences.en: And if they remain persona non grata with the administration, how are they going to get future federal grants for their research?
sentences.zh: 如果他们继续被政府视为“不受欢迎的人”，他们将如何获得未来的联邦研究拨款？

sentences.en: So it showed that while the court case was important, there were other consequences to being in such
sentences.zh: 所以这表明，虽然诉讼很重要，但以这种方式

sentences.en: public opposition to the administration, which had the lever or the the spigot of research money that was critical to the work that was going on at Harvard.
sentences.zh: 公开反对政府也会带来其他后果，因为政府掌握着对哈佛研究工作至关重要的资金命脉。

sentences.en: In other words, the court case does not guarantee that they're going to get access to future grants, future federal funds, et cetera.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，官司并不能保证他们能获得未来的拨款、联邦资金等等。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: How big of a deal is this money that we're talking about for a place as enormous as Harvard that also has tons of donors the way that other Ivy League schools do?
sentences.zh: 对于像哈佛这样庞大且拥有大量捐赠者的常春藤盟校来说，我们谈论的这笔钱到底有多重要？

sentences.en: So understanding Harvard's finances is probably like a Harvard class in and of itself.
sentences.zh: 了解哈佛的财务状况本身可能就像是一门哈佛课程。

sentences.en: At the very least, another episode of The Daily.
sentences.zh: 至少是《The Daily》的另一期节目。

sentences.en: Boring one.
sentences.zh: 无聊的那种。

sentences.en: How dare you?
sentences.zh: 你竟敢这么说？

sentences.en: Basically, Harvard has, along with becoming a place that teaches and educates, has become a big research institution.
sentences.zh: 基本上，哈佛在承担教学和教育职能的同时，也已经成为了一家大型研究机构。

sentences.en: It does work on cancer.
sentences.zh: 它从事癌症研究。

sentences.en: It does work on things related to aerospace that I don't even know how to describe.
sentences.zh: 它还从事一些我甚至不知道该如何描述的航空航天相关工作。

sentences.en: It does stuff on physics and math and all the important things that we think that academia does or is supposed to do to be at the cutting edge of making our society better.
sentences.zh: 它在物理、数学以及我们认为学术界为了引领社会进步而应该做的所有重要领域都有所建树。

sentences.en: To do that work, Harvard has come to rely on grants and funding from the federal government that accounts for about half of their research budget.
sentences.zh: 为了开展这些工作，哈佛已经变得依赖联邦政府的拨款和资助，这占了他们研究预算的一半左右。

sentences.en: And we're talking about billions of dollars, just to be clear, right?
sentences.zh: 我们要明确一点，这可是数十亿美元，对吧？

sentences.en: Billions and billions of dollars.
sentences.zh: 数十亿又数十亿美元。

sentences.en: Harvard, though, don't they have other resources?
sentences.zh: 但是，哈佛难道没有其他资源吗？

sentences.en: I mean, how screwed are they?
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们处境有多糟糕？

sentences.en: They can go out and raise hundreds of millions of dollars.
sentences.zh: 他们可以出去筹集数亿美元。

sentences.en: But to come up with the hole from the federal government may even be too big for Harvard.
sentences.zh: 但要填补联邦政府留下的资金缺口，对哈佛来说可能都太大了。

sentences.en: Because while they do have all of that money in the endowment, the endowment is not a slush fund or a rainy day fund or something they can easily tap into.
sentences.zh: 因为虽然他们确实拥有所有那些捐赠基金，但这些基金并不是应急资金或可以轻易动用的储备金。

sentences.en: It's a more complicated thing than like, oh, wow, Harvard's got the biggest piggy bank in the country.
sentences.zh: 事情比“哦，哇，哈佛拥有全国最大的存钱罐”要复杂得多。

sentences.en: Why don't they just go break into it?
sentences.zh: 为什么他们不直接把它砸开呢？

sentences.en: It's more complicated than that.
sentences.zh: 情况比那复杂得多。

sentences.en: Have you heard examples already of, I'm just making this up, researchers who are, say, declining to go to Harvard because they're worried about their funding getting cut?
sentences.zh: 你是否已经听说过一些例子，比如——我只是随口一说——研究人员因为担心资金被削减而拒绝去哈佛？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And we've heard about how other universities are trying to appeal to these researchers to say, look, we don't have these major questions over us.
sentences.zh: 我们还听说其他大学正试图吸引这些研究人员，告诉他们：看，我们没有这些悬而未决的重大问题。

sentences.en: We've even heard of foreign countries like China trying to recruit some of these researchers
sentences.zh: 我们甚至听说像中国这样的外国也在试图招募其中一些研究人员，

sentences.en: because while Harvard is held up as the most prestigious institution in the country, there are a lot of other
sentences.zh: 因为虽然哈佛被誉为全国最负盛名的机构，但国内还有许多其他

sentences.en: universities in the country that can and do similar work and could facilitate that.
sentences.zh: 大学也能进行类似的工作，并且能够提供便利。

sentences.en: Given the existential threats that the funding cuts could pose to Harvard, are they considering
sentences.zh: 鉴于资金削减可能对哈佛构成的生存威胁，他们是否考虑过

sentences.en: at all trying to reach some kind of deal with the administration despite the language that they put out about how they're going to fight?
sentences.zh: 尽管他们发表了关于要抗争到底的言论，但还是试图与政府达成某种协议？

sentences.en: As far as we know, the corporation, that board that oversees Harvard, has not authorized its lawyers to go back to the table to negotiate.
sentences.zh: 据我们所知，负责监督哈佛的董事会尚未授权其律师重返谈判桌。

sentences.en: Huh.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Why?
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: Because there's a feeling that how can you make a deal with Donald Trump?
sentences.zh: 因为人们觉得，你怎么能和唐纳德·特朗普达成协议呢？

sentences.en: Donald Trump has shown through the deals he made with the law firms that there's Donald
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普通过他与律师事务所达成的协议表明，存在唐纳德·

sentences.en: Trump's understanding of the deals and there's the law firm's understanding of the deals.
sentences.zh: 特朗普对协议的理解，以及律师事务所对协议的理解。

sentences.en: There's a gap between those two.
sentences.zh: 这两者之间存在鸿沟。

sentences.en: You mean like one side thought they were getting something, but then it turned out they were getting something different?
sentences.zh: 你是说一方以为自己得到了什么，结果却得到了不同的东西？

sentences.en: In the case of the law firms, they thought to head off these executive orders from Trump,
sentences.zh: 在律师事务所的案例中，他们以为为了阻止特朗普的这些行政命令，

sentences.en: they were committing tens of millions of dollars in pro bono legal work to uncontroversial causes like helping veterans.
sentences.zh: 他们承诺投入数千万美元的公益法律服务，用于帮助退伍军人等无争议的事业。

sentences.en: And then in the weeks after the deal, Trump started talking publicly about how, oh, these lawyers could go and do trade negotiations for the government.
sentences.zh: 然后在协议达成后的几周内，特朗普开始公开谈论，哦，这些律师可以去为政府进行贸易谈判。

sentences.en: And, oh, these lawyers could go and help the coal industry.
sentences.zh: 而且，哦，这些律师可以去帮助煤炭行业。

sentences.en: And that's not what the firms thought that they agreed to.
sentences.zh: 这并不是律师事务所认为他们同意的事情。

sentences.en: So there's this feeling of like, how can we go to the negotiating table with someone like that who could easily move the goalposts on us?
sentences.zh: 所以人们有一种感觉，怎么能和那样的人坐到谈判桌前，他可以轻易地改变规则呢？

sentences.en: And Harvard is also being lavished with praise.
sentences.zh: 而且哈佛也正受到铺天盖地的赞扬。

sentences.en: Harvard has not always been an institution that is looked favorably upon.
sentences.zh: 哈佛并不总是一个受到好评的机构。

sentences.en: They themselves are coming out of scandal.
sentences.zh: 他们自己也刚从丑闻中走出来。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Of course, there was quite notably the resignation of Claudine Gay, the first female black president
sentences.zh: 当然，最引人注目的是克劳丁·盖伊（Claudine Gay）的辞职，她是哈佛首位黑人女性校长，

sentences.en: of Harvard, who resigned after only six months in the wake of plagiarism allegations and sort of disastrous congressional testimony and over anti-Semitism.
sentences.zh: 她在抄袭指控和灾难性的国会作证以及反犹太主义风波后，仅上任六个月就辞职了。

sentences.en: And the corporation that board was was lambasted for giving into the far right on that.
sentences.zh: 而那个董事会也因为在这一问题上向极右翼妥协而受到猛烈抨击。

sentences.en: And in this instance, the corporation, which has some pretty prominent Democrats on it, is being held up as a central player of the second term resistance.
sentences.zh: 而在这次事件中，拥有几位杰出民主党人的董事会，却被视为第二任期抵抗运动的核心参与者。

sentences.en: And they know the criticisms that the law firms have received for making deals with Trump.
sentences.zh: 他们也知道律师事务所因与特朗普达成协议而受到的批评。

sentences.en: So they know if they go back to the table that that's a pretty big step for them and something that they could really face a lot of blowback for.
sentences.zh: 所以他们知道，如果重返谈判桌，对他们来说是一个很大的举动，可能会面临巨大的反弹。

sentences.en: I mean, it sounds like they're basically kind of stuck.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，听起来他们基本上陷入了困境。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And that was the sort of thing that I found most fascinating about the Harvard story, which was that as they were being praised for fighting back and as everyone said,
sentences.zh: 这正是哈佛故事中最让我着迷的地方，即当他们因反击而受到赞扬，当每个人都说，

sentences.en: oh, they've got this great legal case and they've got these great lawyers,
sentences.zh: 哦，他们有这么好的法律案件，有这么好的律师，

sentences.en: that they were really in an increasingly difficult position and that there weren't great ways out for itself.
sentences.zh: 但他们实际上处于日益困难的境地，而且没有很好的出路。

sentences.en: And in the midst of that, they have continued to be pelted by the administration.
sentences.zh: 在此期间，他们继续受到政府的猛烈抨击。

sentences.en: In the weeks since the funding was first taken away, the administration has doubled down on its funding cuts.
sentences.zh: 在资金首次被撤回后的几周内，政府加倍削减了资金。

sentences.en: It's found new and different ways to strip Harvard of federal money.
sentences.zh: 它找到了新的、不同的方法来剥夺哈佛的联邦资金。

sentences.en: It has made other threats and brought into question whether Harvard is going to be able to keep its tax-exempt status with the IRS.
sentences.zh: 它还发出了其他威胁，并质疑哈佛是否能够保持其在国税局的免税地位。

sentences.en: There's additional measures potentially in place to tax their endowment in a more severe way.
sentences.zh: 还有可能采取额外措施，以更严厉的方式对他们的捐赠基金征税。

sentences.en: Harvard is also getting buried in requests and paperwork from a range of different Justice Department investigations,
sentences.zh: 哈佛还被司法部、教育部、卫生与公众服务部等一系列不同调查的请求和文书工作所淹没。

sentences.en: investigations by the Department of Education, Health and Human Services.
sentences.zh: 哈佛高层担心，随着所有这些目前还是民事的调查，它们会演变成全面的刑事调查。

sentences.en: And there's this fear atop Harvard that with all these different investigations, which for now are civil, that they'll turn into full-blown criminal investigations.
sentences.zh: 最重要的是，在可能发生的最严重的事情之一中，政府要求学校提供所有关于国际学生的信息。

sentences.en: And on top of that, in perhaps one of the most severe things that we've seen, the administration demanded all of the information the school had on international students.
sentences.zh: 当哈佛没有给政府想要的东西时，政府说，我们要取消你们所有国际学生的签证，

sentences.en: And when Harvard didn't give the administration what it wanted, it said, we're taking away the visas for all of your international students,
sentences.zh: 这可能是一个巨大的问题，因为国际学生占哈佛学生总数的四分之一。

sentences.en: which is a potentially huge deal because international students make up a quarter of the student population at Harvard.
sentences.zh: 而且他们通常支付全额学费。

sentences.en: And they tend to pay full price.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 哈佛确实很快提起了诉讼。

sentences.en: And Harvard did quickly sue.
sentences.zh: 他们为此诉诸法庭，并让法官暂时叫停了这一措施。

sentences.en: They went to court over this and got a judge to temporarily halt it.
sentences.zh: 所以目前已经暂停了。

sentences.en: So it's been paused for now.
sentences.zh: 但现在如果你是一名国际学生，你必须查看联邦案卷，看看是否有禁令允许你继续上学。

sentences.en: But now if you're an international student, you have to be checking the federal docket to see if there's an injunction in place that allows you to continue to go to school.
sentences.zh: 这也让人感觉，到目前为止，削减措施都是针对资金的。

sentences.en: It also sort of feels like up until now, the cuts have been aimed at the funding.
sentences.zh: 但切断签证确实是在打击学生群体的结构、学校的身份

sentences.en: But cutting off visas is really striking at the fabric of the student body and the identity of the school
sentences.zh: 以及学校的多样性，这些都超出了哈佛获得的学费收入。

sentences.en: and the diversity of the school, things that go beyond just the tuition money that Harvard gets.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 想想看。

sentences.en: Like, think about that.
sentences.zh: 政府在一次看似相当迅速的行动中，

sentences.en: That the government, in one what appears to be fairly quick action,
sentences.zh: 就能够提出一个问题，即四分之一的学生群体是否能够在秋季入学，即使法官介入并说这不合法。

sentences.en: was able to raise a question of whether a quarter of a student body was going to be able to attend school in the fall, even if a judge steps in and says it's no good.
sentences.zh: 这可是政府权力的重大运用。

sentences.en: Like, that's a major use of the government's power.
sentences.zh: 这里的结论是什么？

sentences.en: What's the takeaway here?
sentences.zh: 你之前提到哈佛是 arguably 最适合、资源最充足的机构之一，可以对抗政府的猛烈抨击。

sentences.en: You mentioned earlier that Harvard is one of the institutions that is arguably one of the best suited and most well-resourced to fight a broadside from the administration.
sentences.zh: 所以我只是有点好奇，特别是对于你这样思考报复议题的人来说，对于那些关注这场斗争的人，结论是什么？

sentences.en: And so I just sort of wonder, especially for you who's thinking about the retribution beat, for people that are looking at this fight, what is the takeaway for them?
sentences.zh: 在特朗普重返办公室之前，我花了很多时间试图了解他在第一任期内的报复是什么样的，

sentences.en: Before Trump came back to office, I spent a lot of time trying to understand what retribution was like in his first term
sentences.zh: 以及他重返办公室后将如何利用权力达到政治目的。

sentences.en: and how he may use his power to his political ends when he came back to office.
sentences.zh: 关于特朗普在第一任期内试图利用权力的事，虽然他确实取得了一些成功，但这真的是通过蛮力取得的成功。

sentences.en: The thing about Trump's attempts to use power in his first term is that while he does have some success, it's really success through blunt force.
sentences.zh: 他基本上是跳着脚闹，直到他的竞争对手被调查。

sentences.en: He basically jumps up and down until his rivals are investigated.
sentences.zh: 即使他提出要求，政府也不总是按照他的意愿行事。

sentences.en: And the government doesn't always do what he wants, even when he demands it.
sentences.zh: 我经常对自己说，我从未见过特朗普做过三点掉头。

sentences.en: And I often said to myself, I've never seen Trump do a three-point turn.
sentences.zh: 他所做的一切都是通过蛮力。

sentences.en: Everything he does is sort of through blunt force.
sentences.zh: 但在第二任期，特别是通过律师事务所和哈佛，

sentences.en: But in the second term, particularly through the law firms and through Harvard,
sentences.zh: 我们看到了他报复手段的复杂性，这肯定超出了我对他能力的想象。

sentences.en: we've seen a sophistication to his retribution that goes beyond certainly what I thought he was capable of.
sentences.zh: 即使你有最好的律师、法律站在你这一边，并且有相当一部分国家支持你，

sentences.en: Even if you have the best lawyers and the law on your side and a significant portion of the country behind you,
sentences.zh: 当你对抗一个肆无忌惮地使用权力的政府时，这并不一定意味着你会成功。

sentences.en: it doesn't necessarily mean you're going to have success when you're fighting back against an administration that is audaciously using its power.
sentences.zh: 如果哈佛能取得胜利，那也不会是一个在法庭上解决的干净利落的事情。

sentences.en: And if there is a victory for Harvard, it will not be a clean, clear-cut thing that is resolved in court.
sentences.zh: 这将是一件需要多年、通过许多不同法庭案件才能解决的事情，

sentences.en: It will be something that will have to play out over many years, over many different court cases,
sentences.zh: 并将迫使哈佛以它从未想过的方式筹集资金或削减其雄心壮志。

sentences.en: and will force Harvard to come up with money or cut back on its ambitions in ways that it didn't think it would ever have to.
sentences.zh: Mike，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Mike, thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请我。

sentences.en: Thanks for having me.
sentences.zh: 我们稍后回来。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.

sentences.zh: 国务卿马可·鲁比奥周三晚间表示，特朗普政府将寻求撤销中国学生的签证，

sentences.en: Secretary of State Marco Rubio said on Wednesday evening that the Trump administration would seek to revoke visas of Chinese students,
sentences.zh: 包括那些与中国共产党有联系的，或在所谓关键领域学习的学生。

sentences.en: including those with ties to the Chinese Communist Party, or studying in what he called critical fields.
sentences.zh: 鲁比奥还表示，国务院将修改所有未来来自中国（包括香港）的签证申请标准。

sentences.en: Rubio also said the State Department would revise criteria for all future visa applications from China, including from Hong Kong.
sentences.zh: 联合国谴责了加沙南部新的援助行动，就在其混乱启动的一天后，当时成千上万的巴勒斯坦人冲向了一个食品分发点。

sentences.en: And the United Nations denounced the new aid operation in southern Gaza, a day after its chaotic launch, which saw thousands of Palestinians rushing a food distribution site.
sentences.zh: 以色列已经禁止人道主义援助进入加沙超过两个月了。

sentences.en: Israel had barred humanitarian aid from entering Gaza for more than two months.
sentences.zh: 虽然物资上周开始进入该飞地，但大部分仍未到达许多加沙人手中。

sentences.en: And while shipments began entering the enclave last week, much of it has yet to reach many Gazans.
sentences.zh: 联合国的批评是在包括美国在内的盟友对旷日持久的战争以及以色列的战争行为表示不满之际提出的。

sentences.en: The UN criticism comes as allies, including the United States, are expressing frustration with the protracted war and Israel's conduct of it.
